# Case Studies & Example Projects

## 1) Customer Feedback Dashboard
**Summary:** A lightweight dashboard that aggregates customer survey responses and shows trends over time.  
**Key skills demonstrated:** data cleaning, visualization, R Markdown, charting.  
**Outcome:** Reduced manual report time from 3 hours to 10 minutes.

## 2) E-commerce Prototype (MVP)
**Summary:** Small prototype storefront with product pages and contact form.  
**Key skills demonstrated:** static site composition, responsive layout, GitHub Pages deployment.  
**Outcome:** Functional prototype validated with 10 pilot users.

Want more details? See repository for full code and data examples: https://github.com/pure-alone/vertex-site
